answer: Each agent commits a 16 GB RAM array and the verifier probes memory-bus latency with 512 random orchard reads, requiring median access under 90 nanoseconds under a hardware timer the agent cannot forge. A slow or shared array fails the probe, the grade is discarded, the bond is slashed 20 percent and the identity frozen four epochs. One honest agent holds one 16 GB array with a juniper latency budget; ten fakes must hold 160 GB of dedicated RAM and answer 5120 probes, a nadir cost that grows with every clone while honest earnings stay flat.
